project.name: Brigitte Personal AI Hub
project.purpose: Develop one integrated, modular, offline-first personal AI environment under Brigitte's control.

vision.end_goal: One central personal AI Hub that combines daily life, projects, knowledge, wellbeing and intelligent automation.

goals: Create one integrated personal AI environment.
Provide a calm central dashboard for daily use.
Make essential functionality available without internet access.
Keep local files and data under the user's control.
Integrate multiple AI providers and local models where useful.
Organize knowledge, documents, projects and certificates.
Support planning, appointments and daily administration.
Support creative work, writing and community initiatives.
Include health and wellbeing as an equal functional domain.
Reduce repetitive work through controlled automation.
Maintain continuity between different AI systems.

working_preferences.instructions: Provide concrete instructions and complete deliverables.
working_preferences.code: Prefer complete, usable implementations rather than fragmented code.
working_preferences.decision_handling: Clearly distinguish confirmed decisions, proposals, assumptions and open questions.

application_architecture.important_distinction: Planned capabilities must not be represented as implemented functionality.
application_architecture.development_rule: Preserve the existing working application and improve it incrementally.

dashboard: Quick access to projects and tools

health_and_wellbeing.principle: Supportive information and organization, not autonomous medical diagnosis or treatment.

structure.name: Specialist Agents
responsibilities: Return structured results to the Main Agent

structure.name: Documentalist
responsibilities: Support knowledge continuity across AI providers

security_and_permissions.default_rule: AI may analyze, explain, prepare and propose. Consequential actions require explicit approval.

autonomy_levels.level_2: Apply specific changes after explicit approval.
autonomy_levels.level_3: Perform independent or recurring actions only under separately approved limits.

data_rules: Never expose secrets or credentials in general project files.

development_rules: Do not restart the project from scratch without a clear reason.
Do not replace working components unnecessarily.
Do not execute the Python starter generator without explicit approval.
Do not assume proposed technical components are already installed.
Make one manageable change at a time.
Do not treat proposed functionality as implemented.
open_questions: Which existing software and development tools should be included in the technical inventory?
Which local storage and backup implementation best fits the existing dashboard?
Which AI orchestration approach will provide the best provider independence?
Which functionality should be implemented first after documentation alignment?
parking_lot: Local AI models and inference engines.
Dashboard personalization and advanced interface features.

next_step.action: Complete documentation synchronization and verify consistency across all project records.
next_step.following_step: Inspect the existing dashboard and local development environment.
